title: Costly Comparison and Informational Inertia
abstract: arXiv:2509.01263v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A price cut can attract consumers while changing what their purchases reveal to later buyers. We study this trade-off in a duopoly with common uncertainty about quality. Consumers have a default seller and may pay to obtain access to the rival together with a private signal. Firms observe purchases and retain their prices between random opportunities to revise them. In a specified pricing experiment, a cut raises current revenue and remains profitable over two arrivals, but loses over three for sufficiently patient firms. The same cut remains profitable when quality is independently redrawn for each buyer. Using analytical arguments and rigorous numerical bounds, we then construct stationary Markov equilibria on three finite price menus in which an informative purchase leads with positive probability to uninformative purchases and unequal prices. translated_title: 有代价的比较与信息惯性
translated_abstract: 降价能够在吸引消费者的同时，改变其购买行为向后续买家所传递的信息。我们在一个对质量存在共同不确定性的双寡头市场中研究这一权衡。消费者拥有一个默认卖家，并可以付费获得接触竞争对手的机会以及一个私人信号。企业观察购买情况，并在两次随机的价格调整机会之间保持其价格不变。在一个特定的定价实验中，降价会提高当期收入，并在两次（消费者）到达之内保持盈利，但对于足够有耐心的企业而言，在三次到达之内则会转为亏损。当质量对每个买家独立重新抽取时，同样的降价仍然保持盈利。随后，我们利用分析论证和严格的数值界限，在三个有限价格菜单上构建了平稳马尔可夫均衡，其中有信息含量的购买会以正概率导致无信息含量的购买以及不相等的价格。这些均衡要求不频繁的重新定价。最后，在固定价格下，我们引入了一个……
tldr: 本文研究双寡头市场中降价的权衡：降价虽能吸引消费者，却会削弱购买行为的信息含量，对足够有耐心的企业在较长时间内可能不再盈利，并且存在由信息性购买引发无信息性购买和价格不相等的平稳均衡，这些均衡要求企业不频繁地重新定价。
en_tdlr: This paper studies a duopoly where price cuts attract consumers but reduce the informativeness of purchases, showing that cuts can become unprofitable for sufficiently patient firms over longer horizons, and constructs stationary Markov equilibria in which informative purchases lead with positive probability to uninformative purchases and unequal prices, requiring infrequent repricing.
